newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnair says redeems three leased planes.
newsitem.headline: Finnair says redeems three leased planes.

text.p: Finnish national carrier Finnair Oy said on Wednesday it had redeemed three leased aircraft for a total price of 380 million markka from one German and one Finnish seller.
"The combined acquisition price of these three aircraft is about 380 million markka," Finnair said in a statement.
Finnair said it redeemed two Airbus A300s, in the airline's service since 1986, from the German group PATITO Verwaltungsgesellschaft mbH & Co. Mobilien KG.
It also redeemed one McDonnel Douglas MD-82, in use since 1990, from Finnish finance house Merita Rahoitus Oy, it said.
Finnair paid for the aircraft out of cash funds, it said.
